description: Count the total number of Security Case Evidence in OneUptime, optionally filtered by query criteria. Returns a single number. Useful for dashboards, reports, or checking if records exist before listing.

query.description: Optional filter criteria. If omitted, counts all Security Case Evidence. Each field accepts a direct value (exact match) or an operator object {"_type": "<Operator>", "value": ...}. Operators: EqualTo, NotEqual, IsNull, NotNull, EqualToOrNull, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, InBetween (numbers/dates), Search (partial text), Includes (array of values). Example — items from the last 24 hours: {"createdAt": {"_type": "GreaterThan", "value": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}}.
